remarks: Judicial Sale – Court of King’s Bench. +55 Adult Bungalow Complex. Welcome to this 2-bedroom townhouse-style condo in Callingwood Village, located in the desirable west Edmonton community of Callingwood South. This 1988-built unit offers a functional layout with approximately 1,050 sq ft above grade plus a partially finished basement. Situated in a well-established complex close to parks, schools, shopping, public transit and amenities. Property is sold “as is, where is” with no warranties or representations. All offers must be submitted with Schedule “A” and are subject to Court approval. Access may be limited and property condition is unknown; buyers to verify all information. Ideal opportunity for investors or buyers looking to add value. (id:67522)
